_comment: Parts of a thing. 'barrel'/'muzzle'/'tip' feed barrels; 'sight' is only descriptive. Melee uses the same 3 parts: handle (= stock, rear), blade/head (= body, front) and tip (= muzzle). The 3 gun parts: stock (behind the trigger), body (front) and barrel; 'with a bazooka body' / 'with the body of a bazooka' swaps the part.
